purpose: Replace the unfalsifiable label 'controlled opposition' with testable mechanisms, evidence requirements and disconfirmation rules.
core_rule: Never store controlled_opposition as an intrinsic boolean property. Store a specific alleged or observed mechanism, actor, date, evidence and counterevidence.

mechanisms.definition: State or law-enforcement personnel or informants enter an organization or movement to collect intelligence or influence activity.
minimum_evidence: official record, court record, declassified file, inspector-general finding or multiple strong corroborating sources
falsifiers: claimed infiltrator predates or postdates alleged operation
documents show independent activity rather than directed influence

mechanisms.definition: An external actor intentionally creates discord, reputational damage or organizational dysfunction inside an opposition group.
minimum_evidence: documented instruction, operation record, payment/communication chain or credible admission
falsifiers: conflict is better explained by ordinary factional disagreement
no operational link to alleged controller

mechanisms.definition: An opposition actor changes incentives or behavior after receiving access, office, funding, institutional status or other benefits from an incumbent system.
minimum_evidence: documented benefit plus dated behavioral/policy change
evidence of dependency or negotiated exchange when control is alleged
falsifiers: organization continues costly opposition despite benefit
funding is unrestricted and governance remains demonstrably independent

mechanisms.definition: A campaign presented as independent grassroots activity is materially organized or financed by an undisclosed sponsor.
minimum_evidence: funding records, contracts, internal communications, disclosure violation or investigative documentation

mechanisms.definition: An actor spends or communicates to increase the visibility of an opponent believed to be easier to defeat or more polarizing.
minimum_evidence: documented spending/message plus candidate/opponent and timing
intent evidence when claiming strategic purpose
falsifiers: spending actually attacks rather than amplifies opponent
no evidence of intended electoral strategy

mechanisms.definition: A funder acquires durable agenda-setting leverage over a nominally independent organization.
minimum_evidence: governance rights, conditional grants, documented pressure or consistent donor-directed program constraints

mechanisms.definition: Consultants, vendors, legal/PR firms or contractors gain outsized influence over an organization's decisions through dependency or information asymmetry.
minimum_evidence: contracts, recurring payments, decision records, documented authority or dependency
falsifiers: no evidence vendor shaped policy or strategy

mechanisms.definition: An opposition actor's reach or survival becomes dependent on a platform, payment processor, host, advertiser or distributor that can shape behavior through access rules.
minimum_evidence: platform enforcement or contractual terms linked to behavior

mechanisms.definition: Claim that a participant secretly reports to authorities or deliberately pushes a group toward harmful/illegal behavior on behalf of another actor.
minimum_evidence: court/official record, payment or handler communications, verified identity/admission
falsifiers: claim originates solely from factional accusation

mechanisms.definition: Opposition capacity is reduced through factional division, splintering, rivalry or incompatible incentives.
minimum_evidence: observable splits, competing organizations, public conflict and consequences
mechanisms.note: Fragmentation can be endogenous. External orchestration must be separately proven.

mechanisms.definition: Organization or actor is independently financed/governed and meaningfully opposes the target system despite overlap, negotiation or partial cooperation.
mechanisms.purpose: Positive counter-hypothesis that prevents every compromise or adjacency from becoming evidence of control.

historical_anchor.limitation: A historical state program establishes that these mechanisms can occur; it does not establish their presence in any modern case.

anti-patterns: They criticize X, therefore X controls them.
They received money from Y, therefore Y controls all their activity.
They failed to achieve their stated goal, therefore they were fake opposition.
They share some positions with the establishment, therefore they are controlled.
A hostile community repeats the label, therefore it is established fact.
